prompt: Create a confirmation dialog that asks 'Are you sure you want to delete this project?' with Cancel and Delete buttons. The delete button should be red/danger. Wire up the open/close state.
assertions: Uses useState for controlled open state with open={state}
Dialog has a label prop for accessibility
Uses onHide handler to set state to false
Uses slot='footer' on the button container
Does NOT use hide() directly -- uses requestClose() or state setter
